guard_cards.name: Directional kill-rule normalization
guard_cards.problem: Current kill checks compare variant metrics against micro baseline directly, creating constant fail states.
guard_cards.paper_change: Replace absolute reduction checks with directional delta checks tied to variant intent and guard class.
guard_cards.expected_effect: Eliminate false negative kills while preserving strictness on risk metrics.

guard_cards.name: Two-tier kill gate
guard_cards.problem: Single hard gate rejects variants with strong false-cut gains but small drawdown trade-offs.
guard_cards.paper_change: Tier 1: hard risk gate (false-cut, tail loss). Tier 2: soft efficiency gate (delta thresholds).
guard_cards.expected_effect: Keep safety strict while allowing viable survivors to proceed.

guard_cards.name: Micro-slice archetype weighting
guard_cards.problem: Micro-slice composition may overweight certain archetypes and distort kill outcomes.
guard_cards.paper_change: Apply fixed archetype weights and require minimum representation per archetype bucket.
guard_cards.expected_effect: Stabilize variant comparison and reduce slice bias.

guard_cards.name: V3 survivor escalation path
guard_cards.problem: V3 already clears false-cut gate but fails kill-gate bundle.
guard_cards.paper_change: Define conditional survivor rule: if false-cut clears and delta positive, route to guarded re-test under revised Tier-2 checks.
guard_cards.expected_effect: Preserve strong safety wins while validating efficiency in controlled rerun.
